Definition: Ataroth, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ataroth was a town claimed by the children of Gad when they asked for land east of the Jordan, and they built it up again as their own. The name also marks a boundary town in Ephraim's allotment, on the border running down toward the Jordan.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Ataroths show how the land was divided and settled by real families, and a town's name in the record is a deed as much as a place.
